statement: Writes into pool_manager.connection_pool_kw (urllib3 internal, poking at kubernetes client internals) which is fragile across urllib3/kubernetes versions, and the shared custom context is also used for HTTPS proxy connections; tests only mock the context rather than verifying a real handshake with a non-strict CA.
Tests patch create_urllib3_context and use a fake CA, so they never verify that an EKS CA lacking the Authority Key Identifier actually passes TLS verification.
